title: Get Drunk on the Holy Ghost
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he reveals the secret to experiencing joy unspeakable and full of glory, and how to become a carrier of the wine of heaven to the world. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris shares the biblical promise of being filled with the Spirit, just as we are filled with wine, and how this supernatural anointing can change lives forever. If you're feeling thirsty for a deeper connection with God and a sense of purpose to share His joy with others, tune in to this inspiring message.
